title: The Mantid Oracle
description: A silhouetted man stands in the foreground observing a large ornate golden oval frame containing three ethereal winged female figures with floral crowns whose bodies merge into a swirling orange flame-like vortex. Above the frame perches a giant green praying mantis with translucent wings, while below it an orange tabby cat, grey cat, and black cat rest near an open book and a lit candle on stacked books, surrounded by floating bubbles and pink flowers.
prompt: A giant emerald green praying mantis with delicate wings perches atop a large ornate golden oval frame. Inside the frame are three beautiful winged women with flower crowns whose lower bodies dissolve into a swirling fiery orange vortex. In the foreground a black silhouette of a man watches, while three cats (orange tabby, grey, and black) sit near an open illuminated book and a lit red candle on stacked books. The scene is filled with floating transparent bubbles and pink flowers against a dark teal patterned wallpaper background with smaller framed pictures, in a highly detailed fantasy surreal style.
